name: Impostor Ship
hook: Do your tasks. Find the impostor.
how: The crew fixes the ship. One player is secretly the impostor. Report a body or hit the button, talk it out in chat and vote someone off.
controls: WASD or drag to walk, E or USE for tasks, Q to kill, R to report
uses: Your role is sealed so only you can read it (the host deals, so it can too).
The host's browser deals roles, checks kills and counts votes; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots walk the ship, do tasks, report bodies, chat and vote. A bot impostor hunts too.
ideas: Add a second impostor for 8 or more players
Set it in a haunted mansion
